news.title: Magnus Steel and Infra Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 450 million in funding
news.body: Magnus Steel and Infra Limited announced a private placement to issue 45,000,000 shares at an issue price of INR 10 per share for gross proceeds of INR 450,000,000 on December 22, 2025. The transaction will include participation from new investors Nautilus Private Capital Ltd for 10,000,000 shares, MGO High Convection Fund Incorporated VCC Sub Fund 10,000,000 shares, BluCreek Real Estate Limited 15,000,000 shares and Manoj Sawant 10,000,000 shares. The transaction has been approved by shareholders of company.
